title: Draw It In, rebuilt Klein-only: crop, edit, stitch - no render phase, no paste, no mask
description: Replaces the SDXL render + rembg + paste + LanPaint architecture with a single Klein 9B edit on a cropped region. Proven live 2026-08-25: kleinEdit_003 put the man behind the tiger in 15s on one image and one sentence, against 38s and no interaction from the shipped flow. Crop-stitch stays (Klein resamples the whole input to a megapixel target); the feather stays (Law 2 re-grade). 9B only - 4B left the users ink in the output. Open measurement: context_from_mask_extend_factor vs Law 1. Supersedes MPI-618s live run and MPI-596s design. Design: brief.md.
